# Topological Sort

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Topological Sort

In topological sorting, a vertex is placed before all the vertices it directs to such that all edges are directed forward.

![A Directed Acyclic Graph](data:image/png;base64,)

So, the topological sort for this graph is [B, E, A, C, D].

![Topological Sorting](data:image/png;base64,)

As you can see, the vertices are sorted such that all edges are directed forward.
